name: express-pug-demo
description: - create folder express-pug-demo - move to the folder -> cd express-pug-demo - package.json -> npm init -y - edit package.json: "type": "module", - install : npm i express pug - npm install --save-dev nodemon - create views folder - create file index.pug under that - add code in index.pug - create app.js, add code - run using node app.js - check output localhost:3000 in browser
